findings.reason: the done-when measures "the whole census before and after (463 groups at 646bbacf5)" in the manifest, so a node whose faithful census reports 476 either records a before/after the plan calls wrong or, worse, edits its census to force 463 and corrupts the very instrument the measure rests on; the fix is to correct or drop the 463/559/12,757 baseline.
findings.text: the done-when pins the whole-census baseline as "(463 groups at 646bbacf5)" and §4's prose (line 96-97) states "463 groups of identical bodies span 559 test files and 12,757 lines", but applying the section's own definition exactly to `tests/` at `646bbacf5` yields 476 groups, 563 files, 12,859 lines; the three-group figures the section actually builds on (64 + 40 + 22 files = 126 files, 1,038 lines) reproduce to the line, so the same instrument that produced the load-bearing numbers contradicts the headline total

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `646bbacf5` resolves in this repository ("plan the fixes a codebase health review found, in sprint S26"), `tests/conftest.py` exists (1,231 lines), and `tests/helpers/` is a new directory the section creates; §4 cites no href whose target would 404. rubric_items.done_when: pass — §4's done-when is measurable (census reports the three groups with no copy outside `tests/helpers/` and `tests/conftest.py`; touched test files pass at head with base, built at dispatch; line delta over `tests/` negative) and declares an executed negative control (a replaced helper's import pointed at a raising stub fails its importers); I reproduced the section's load-bearing figures independently at `646bbacf5` and they match exactly.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §4's evidence (the census script the node writes beside its log, the before/after census in the manifest) and its write paths (`tests/helpers/`, `tests/conftest.py`, the 126 test files) are all in-repo durable paths; no session-scratchpad or node-local temporary path is named.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §4 introduces `tests/helpers/`, a capability name, and no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag reaches a file or symbol; the group names it cites (`_git`, `home`) are the code's own.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §4's stated method (hash the normalised body, arguments and decorators of every module-level non-`test_` function in `tests/`) yields 476 groups spanning 563 files and 12,859 lines at `646bbacf5`, not the 463 / 559 / 12,757 the section asserts and pins into its done-when.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §4 carries one deliverable, deduplicating the three helper groups copied into ≥20 files, into one home each.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §4 declares no depends-on/informs/gates of its own and needs none; the plan's sole relationship (`plan-after: the-suite-is-green-at-head`) is a sequencing that no §4 section waits on, and §4 names no cross-unit dependency it lacks.
